description: Everything SANA is allowed to say that is not a protocol step. These are locked and hashed exactly like medical content, because the sentence SANA says when it cannot match is as safety-critical as any step — it is the one that has to send the human to real help instead of guessing.

acknowledge.text: Okay. I'm here. Tell me what you can see.
acknowledge.note: Played the instant listening starts, so there is never dead silence.

thinking.text: Thank you. Give me a moment.

unmatched.text: I'm not sure enough about this one to guide you, and I won't guess. Call for help now, and stay with them.
unmatched.note: Master prompt section 3, graceful uncertainty. Spoken whenever the match is below threshold or absent. This line is the reason the model is never allowed to author prose: without it, an uncertain system fills the silence with something plausible.

not_right.text: Alright, I've set that aside. Tell me again what you can see.
not_right.note: Spoken when the human rejects the suggested match at the confirm beat.

step_done.text: Well done. Tell me when you're ready for the next one.
step_done.note: Between steps. Steadying language, master prompt section 2.

protocol_complete.text: That's everything I have for this. Stay with them, keep watching their breathing, and wait for help to arrive.
protocol_complete.note: End of the last step. SANA does not improvise beyond the library.

escalation_confirmed.text: Good. Keep the phone with you, and read them the summary on the screen when they ask.
escalation_confirmed.note: After the human taps the emergency-dial control. SANA never dials.

no_emergency_number.text: I don't have an emergency number set for this site, so I can't dial for you. Use your phone's own emergency call.
no_emergency_number.note: Decision 0003: a missing number fails loudly. SANA never substitutes a plausible default.
